description: The deliverable is findings. Done means findings are evidence-backed, coverage is stated and every unknown is recorded. The criteria are exactly the two the audit path supplies - canonical ownership and source and data contracts - both owed by the Auditor's first pass, which is what AUDIT collects. Criterion 1 is deliberately not among them: DEFINITION_OF_DONE section 3 gives it to Context Discovery, whose mandate runs in the kernel prologue and not in any stage a template contains, so no stage in an audit path may supply it without breaking the one-owner-per-criterion rule - and a profile demanding a verdict no stage in its template owns is a profile that can never complete.

3.note: static analysis plus the capability graph; self-assertion is never evidence
